DECLARATION OF APPEARANCE ON BEHALF OF CORPORATION PURSUANT TO CCP 116.540 (B)-(H) FILED BY DEFENDANT AUTO RETURN

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF AUG-08-2008 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF AUG-08-2008 BY PAUL SLAVIT. ALL PARTIES PRESENT. EXHIBITS FROM BOTH SIDES RETAINED. DEFENDANT WAIVES SERVICE. CLERK: S. VANTREE. NOT REPORTED. (506).
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF AUG-08-2008 - JUDGMENT.

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF MOSKOWITZ, DINA IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT AUTO RETURN THE AVAILABLE EVIDENCE WAS NOT SUFFICIENT TO ESTABLISH DEFENDANT'S LIABILITY FOR THE DAMAGE TO PLAINTIFF'S CAR.
